header.sub: Pause your activity or delete your account. Each action requires your password.

actif.sub: Shops and customers can see you and you can receive deliveries.

pause.sub: You are hidden and receive no new deliveries until you resume.

desactive.sub: You are hidden and receive no new deliveries. Automatic resume on {{date}} — or right now.

suspendu.sub: Your account was suspended by your company or by Shoneya. Contact them to find out more.

banni.sub: Your account was blocked by Shoneya. Contact support to find out more.

pause.sub: You are hidden and receive no new deliveries. Deliveries already accepted continue. Resume whenever you want.
pause.confirm: Your activity will be paused until you resume it from this menu.

desactiver.sub: Like a pause, with an automatic resume after 30 days. You can resume earlier.
desactiver.confirm: Your activity will be suspended for 30 days, then resume automatically.

supprimer.sub: You will be logged out and can no longer sign in. Your personal data and documents are permanently erased after 30 days. Not possible while you still have deliveries in progress or money in your wallet.
supprimer.confirm: ⚠️ This is permanent: you will no longer be able to sign in to this account. Delivery history is kept anonymously.

livreurSecDanger.erreur: Unable to load your account status.

toasts.repriseOk: Activity resumed — you are visible again
